prompts.instructions: intake is active. When assigned an intake, read its instructions at resource metaform://intake/procedure, with metaform intake prompt, or the intake tool's prompt command, and follow the procedure it serves. The forms it records are at resource metaform://intake/schema. The recording commands are start, then element and join as reasoned, show to read back, and finish; their arguments are in the intake tool's schema, or read metaform help intake.
prompts.no_intake:
FIRST RUN. Metaform has not analysed this project yet. Handle this first, even if the person asked for something else; tell them you'll get to their request right after.
1. Ask the person once, in your own words: "This is the first time Metaform is running in this project. I'd like to do a quick analysis so I understand how it fits together. You can watch it build live in a browser view on this machine. Want me to start?" 2. If they say no, drop it and help with what they asked. 3. If they say yes, do all of this in order without asking again: b. Start the browser view: web tool, command start. Give them the address. If it fails, tell them what it said and stop. c. Start ONE fresh subagent. Its whole task: "Read resource metaform://intake/procedure and follow it exactly, recording with the intake tool." Do not summarize the procedure for it, do not split the work, and do not do the analysis yourself unless you cannot start a subagent. d. When it finishes, tell them it's done and invite their questions.
prompts.register_step: a. Register this folder: metaform tool, command register.
prompts.schema_pointer: The schema this procedure binds, metaform.axiom, is at resource metaform://intake/schema, or the intake tool's schema command.
prompts.unfinished: An intake was started but aborted and still remains to be completed.

element.namespace_address: The element's dotted address, formed as the intake procedure says, such as code.timer.kitchen, or core for the core element.
element.role: AUE, CQU, DE, SE or NE, as defined in the intake procedure. The core element has none.
element.name_length: How many of the address's last segments form the element's name, a whole number from 1, as defined in the intake procedure.
element.name: The element's name as the project calls it.
element.refs: Where the element is found: a list of references, each a key and a value, such as path and src/timer.py.
element.within: The address of the element that holds this one, or core.
element.condition: unbuilt, under-construction, built or broken. Leave it out when the part's state is not in question.
element.note: Free text kept with the element; an exclusion is a note that starts with "exclude:".

join.receiver: The address of the receiving element, the RE, whose purpose the join records.
join.elements: The addresses of the providing elements, the PEs, that serve the receiver's purpose.
join.provider: The address of one providing element, a PE, held by the join.
join.purpose: The receiver's operative purpose, the OP, as defined in the intake procedure.
join.ef: The encounter function, the EF: what the providing elements do for the receiver, in active voice.
join.ifd: sends, receives or both: the information flow direction, as defined in the intake procedure.
join.refs: Where the join is found: a list of references, each a key and a value.
join.condition: unbuilt, under-construction, built or broken. Leave it out when the part's state is not in question.
join.note: Free text kept with the join; an exclusion is a note that starts with "exclude:".
